body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> YuKyung Technologies(President Sam Sik Kim, www.myviliv.com) has released its 7-inch multimedia PMP 'X70 series' in Korea market, which features a WVGA TFT-LCD screen and a 8200mA detachable battery supporting up to 9.5 hours of video playing.
(Picture: 'X70 VANT' model that was showcased at CES 2008)

'X70 VANT(60GB)' and 'X70 VANT SHINE(8GB)' are capable of using wireless internet with its built-in WLAN and exclusive web browser 'Fast Web' reducing size of any web pages to be fitted with it and opened quickly. Running on RMI Alchemy AU1250 700MHz CPU, these navigation devices are equipped with 256MB memory, compared to the 120MB other mobile multimedia devices have.

'X70 VANT EXPRESS(60GB)' and 'X70 STUDY(30/60GB)' support DIP(Dictionary In the Picture)' functionality. Other features included PDF/image viewer, PIMS(personal information management system), T-DMB, TV-out, and more.
